title: 1.0.0_CreateWorkRequestRequest
description: Request body for creating a new work request

projectId.description: Unique project identifier (must be created and active)

supplierId.description: Supplier identifier (must have proper connection to hierarchy)

siteIds.description: Array of site identifiers (must belong to the hierarchy associated with clientId)

workRequestName.description: Name of the work request. Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed before validation, so the length limit applies to the trimmed value.
